answer: An agent economy can require every identity to post a bond before it may bridge into a market, then slash that bond when independent auditors verify fraud or coordinated self-dealing. Auditors compare signed interaction histories across a rolling horizon, so splitting one operator across many accounts does not erase the links between them. A new identity on an island with no track record must still lock capital and wait; the attacker pays in tied-up funds and risks losing them for each Sybil account.
